mapper.select: SELECT id, permission_code AS permissionCode, permission_name AS permissionName, create_time AS createTime, create_user AS createUser, update_time AS updateTime, update_user AS updateUser FROM sys_permission WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, permission_code AS permissionCode, permission_name AS permissionName, create_time AS createTime, create_user AS createUser, update_time AS updateTime, update_user AS updateUser FROM sys_permission WHERE permission_code = #{permissionCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, permission_code AS permissionCode, permission_name AS permissionName, create_time AS createTime, create_user AS createUser, update_time AS updateTime, update_user AS updateUser FROM sys_permission
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_permission ( permission_code, permission_name, create_time, create_user ) VALUES ( #{permissionCode}, #{permissionName}, NOW(), #{createUser} )
